title: Best Coffee Makers 2026: Drip, Cold Brew & More
summary: We compared the top-rated drip coffee makers of 2026 using lab tests from Consumer Reports and expert brew tests. The Technivorm Moccamaster is the best overall, the OXO Brew 9-Cup is the best value, and the Breville Precision Brewer is best if you like to tune your cup. We also include a programmable family pick, a compact brewer, a budget machine and a cold brew maker.
method: We started from lab and expert tests, including Consumer Reports and hands-on brew tests that check water temperature, bloom and extraction. Machines certified by the Specialty Coffee Association and those that score well for brew quality, ease of cleaning and reliability ranked higher. Each pick below is matched to a different kind of coffee drinker.
assumptions: Prices change often, so check the current price on Amazon before you buy. Capacity is listed in cups of about 5 oz, as machines measure it.

products.name: Technivorm Moccamaster KBGV Select
why: Hand-built in the Netherlands around a copper heating element, it is built to hold brewing water in the ideal temperature window for the whole cycle.
It is certified by the Specialty Coffee Association, so the brew temperature and time meet the standard serious coffee people use.
specs: Glass carafe with a hot plate
Made to be repaired, with a long warranty
cons: High price for a drip machine
No timer or app, so you cannot schedule a brew
Hot plate keeps coffee warm but can cook it if left too long
products.best_for: People who drink drip coffee every day and want the best cup without fuss
products.skip_if: You want a programmable timer or a thermal carafe on a tight budget

products.name: OXO Brew 9-Cup Coffee Maker
why: A well-regarded mid-price brewer with the Specialty Coffee Association seal, so the water temperature and brew time are checked, not guessed.
The rainmaker shower head spreads water evenly over the grounds, and the stainless thermal carafe keeps coffee hot without a hot plate.
pros: Thermal carafe, no burnt hot-plate taste
cons: Takes more counter space than a compact brewer
Plastic body feels lighter than premium machines
products.best_for: A small household that wants café-quality drip without paying Moccamaster money
products.skip_if: You regularly brew more than 9 cups at once

products.name: Breville Precision Brewer Thermal
why: It lets you adjust brew temperature and bloom time, and has a pour-over mode, so you can tune the cup to the beans you buy.
It is certified by the Specialty Coffee Association and stores your favorite settings, which suits people who like to experiment.
pros: Most control of any drip machine here
Thermal carafe keeps coffee hot for hours
Good for light and dark roasts alike
cons: More settings than casual drinkers need
products.best_for: Home brewers who change beans often and want to dial in the cup
products.skip_if: You just want to press one button and pour

products.name: Cuisinart PerfecTemp 14-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker (DCC-3200)
why: Consumer Reports has named it among the best-performing drip machines for brew quality, a rare score at this price.
It brews up to 14 cups, so it covers a big family or a morning with guests, and the timer lets you wake up to fresh coffee.
pros: Strong brew performance in lab testing
Large capacity at a fair price
cons: Glass carafe on a hot plate, so coffee loses flavor if it sits
Not as durable-feeling as premium machines
products.best_for: Big households that want a reliable timer-based machine
products.skip_if: You drink one or two cups at a time

products.name: OXO Brew 8‑Cup Coffee Maker
why: The OXO Brew 8‑Cup Coffee Maker offers a compact, sturdy design that brews excellent pots quickly.
Its thermal carafe prevents drips while pouring, and the filter basket is easy to fill.
cons: Filter basket could be easier to fill
Plastic body and thinner glass than pricier machines
products.skip_if: You need a larger capacity or programmable features

products.name: Ninja 12‑Cup Programmable Coffee Brewer
why: The Ninja 12‑Cup Brewer delivers consistent performance at a fair price, with numerous programmable features.
It keeps temperature stable for more than two hours and includes a cleaning cycle.
cons: Plastic body and thinner glass than premium machines
Feels less durable than pricier models
products.best_for: Those who want a quick, programmable brew
products.skip_if: You need a premium build or advanced customization

products.name: OXO Brew Cold Brew Coffee Maker
why: The OXO Cold Brew Coffee Maker was praised for its large "rainmaker" showerhead that ensures even water distribution, producing smooth, balanced coffee with rich chocolatey notes.
Its 32‑ounce glass carafe keeps concentrate fresh for up to two weeks, and the sealed design prevents drips when pouring.
cons: Reservoir has no lid for brewing
Cold brew only, it is not a hot drip machine
products.best_for: Households that regularly drink cold brew
products.skip_if: You prefer hot coffee or a drip machine
